description: An interactive chapter review tool for Grade 7 Science (NCERT Chapter 3: Electricity — Circuits and their Components). The tool provides a comprehensive multi-modal review experience. Learn mode: visual reference for all 7 circuit symbols (cell, battery, lamp, LED, switch ON/OFF, wire) with terminal identification, covering key concepts from the entire chapter. Practice mode: 6 multiple-choice and symbol-identification questions testing knowledge of circuit symbols, terminal polarity (+ and −), complete vs open circuits, conductor/insulator classification, LED polarity, and fused lamps. Immediate feedback with explanations after each answer. Hints available (toggleable). Real World mode: 4 everyday applications (torchlight, room light, doorbell, solar light) showing how circuit diagrams represent real devices. Hands-On mode: 4 safe revision activities (build circuit, make switch, test conductors, draw diagrams). Purple theme colour suggesting review/assessment. Indian school context. Clean educational UI suitable for self-paced revision by Grade 7 students.

content_coverage.chapter: Chapter 3: Electricity — Circuits and their Components
sections_covered: 3.2 A Simple Electrical Circuit (cell, battery, lamp, LED, making lamp glow, electrical circuit, switch)
key_concepts: Electric cell as portable source of electrical energy
Battery = two or more cells in series
Incandescent lamp filament glows when heated by current
LED passes current in one direction only (polarity matters)
Switch completes (ON/closed) or breaks (OFF/open) a circuit
Current direction: positive to negative terminal
Circuit diagram = representation using standard symbols

teaching_notes: Activate AFTER showing the chapter concept map image and AFTER the student has completed the summary discussion. Say: 'Let's see how much you remember! Start with the Practice quiz — it covers ALL the topics we studied: cells, batteries, lamps, LEDs, switches, circuits, conductors, and insulators.' If the student struggles, guide them to Learn mode: 'Go back to Learn mode to revise that symbol, then try again.' Use Real World mode as a reward: 'Great job! Now see how everything connects to real devices.' Purple theme to signal review/assessment mood.
instructions_for_student: Time to review everything you've learned! Start with Practice mode to test your knowledge of circuit symbols, components, and behaviour. If you get stuck, switch to Learn mode to revise any symbol. Then explore Real World to see how circuits power everyday devices, and Hands-On for fun revision activities. Try to score full marks in Practice!
